name: Stadtgasthaus Haymon
kurzbeschreibung:
**The City Tavern Haymon in Innsbruck**

Welcome to **Stadtgasthaus Haymon**, a cozy and traditional inn right in the heart of **Innsbruck**. Since 1896, we’ve been serving authentic Tyrolean cuisine in a warm, rustic atmosphere.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized pancakes with apricot jam—paired with a glass of local **Apfelstrudel** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier**. Our menu also features hearty dishes like **Schlutzkrapfen** (spinach-filled dumplings) and **Tiroler Gröstl**, a rustic potato and bacon hash.

After your meal, relax with a **Schnaps** or a cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** (Tyrolean alpine cheese) and enjoy the lively ambiance. Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck’s** historic old town or taking a short stroll to the **Nordkette**, our central location makes us the perfect starting point for your adventures.

Come visit us at **Stadtgasthaus Haymon**—where tradition meets modern hospitality in the heart of **Tirol**!
